name: Nigeria
shortSummary: Nigeria is India's largest trading partner in Africa, driven substantially by crude oil imports and a sizeable Indian business community operating across Nigerian manufacturing and services.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Nigeria is among India's largest African sources of crude oil and liquefied natural gas.
A large resident Indian business community operates across Nigerian manufacturing and pharmaceuticals.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued energy and defence-industrial ties
recentDevelopments.description: Nigeria remained one of India's largest African trading partners, with continued crude oil and LNG trade alongside defence-industrial engagement.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Anchors India's broader West African economic engagement.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India and Nigeria establish diplomatic relations shortly after Nigerian independence.

historicalEvents.title: Offshore Patrol Vessel Export
historicalEvents.description: Nigeria takes delivery of an Indian-built offshore patrol vessel, reflecting growing defence-industrial cooperation.

defenceCooperation.name: Offshore patrol vessel export
defenceCooperation.description: Indian shipyard-built patrol vessel delivered to the Nigerian Navy.

multilateralRelations.detail: Nigeria participates in G20 outreach engagements.
